correctness.rationale: For any n>=4 over an algebraically closed field of arbitrary characteristic the source uses the face fan, not the normal fan, of P=conv(e_i-e_j) in the saturated root lattice sum z_i=0, dimension n-1. Every proper face is indexed by disjoint nonempty top and bottom index sets A,B of a linear functional and spans the incidence vectors of K_{|A|,|B|}. Its cone has |A||B| primitive rays and rank |A|+|B|-1. It is simplicial precisely when one side is singleton, and such a star-tree incidence set extends to an integral root-lattice basis, so is smooth. Every nonsmooth cone contains a minimal 2x2 square cone, giving exactly 6*C(n,4) irreducible reduced singular components of dimension n-4. At each minimal square cone the saturated four-index root sublattice and remaining quotient coordinates w_c=e_c-e_b give the product fan of n-4 copies of P1, hence component (P1)^(n-4). Four rays have primitive parallelogram relation and the transverse completed ring is K[[u,v,s,t]]/(uv-st), the ordinary threefold node. The root polytope is reflexive and terminal because its only lattice points are 0 and roots and the polar has integral 0/1 vertices. The anticanonical polar face dual to the square cone is a unit (n-4)-cube, inducing O(1,...,1), so each component has degree (n-4)! and reduced singular support total degree 6*C(n,4)*(n-4)!=n!/4. Independent complete enumeration of disjoint two-by-two pairs for 4<=n<=8 recovers counts 6,30,90,210,420 and exact degrees 6,30,180,1260,10080; all n rests on cone and lattice proofs.
residual_risks: This is the reduced singular support and generic transverse node, not the completed geometry at intersections.
Anticanonical intersection on the union means sum of top-dimensional reduced components, not a Jacobian singular-scheme cycle.

value.rationale: The full type-A root polytope is a standard natural terminal toric Fano family. Its reduced singular locus has a complete, uniform K2,2-indexed component geometry, a canonical node transverse singularity and an exact anticanonical cycle degree in every dimension. These intrinsic geometry and intersection-theory data go substantially beyond the known binary smoothness obstruction or tiny face enumeration and can serve later toric intersection and deformation calculations.
residual_risks: Does not classify nonreduced singular structure or local analytic behavior at component intersections.
